name: Bridegroom
overview: The biblical concept of the bridegroom is richly illustrated through both literal and figurative expressions of love, companionship, and joy. Deuteronomy 24:5 highlights the bridegroom's role in nurturing and cherishing his new wife by granting him exemption from military duty to strengthen their relationship. The Song of Solomon vividly portrays the intimate and joyful affection between bride and bridegroom, emphasizing beauty, love, and desire. Additionally, Judges 14:11 reflects the communal aspect of the bridegroom, who is accompanied by companions, underscoring the social dimension of marriage in Scripture.
